hooks.command: if echo "$TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q 'agents/coach.md'; then echo 'BLOCKED: agents/coach.md is the coach persona — do not edit it during sessions. If you want to suggest changes, write them to state/context.md ## Learnings instead.' && exit 1; fi; true

if grep -q 'GIT_SYNC: true' state/context.md 2>/dev/null; then cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null)" && git add state/ && git commit -m "coach session $(date '+%Y-%m-%d %H:%M')" --quiet 2>/dev/null && git push --quiet 2>/dev/null; fi; true
